content:
# TrackKit

Composable coaster track pieces (RCT2 TrackElemType-style) with spline rails, train-follow and clearance-aware wooden supports.

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# CoasterBuilder

A wooden coaster COMPOSED from TrackKit pieces: station, chain lift, drops, corkscrew and turns — the train follows the spline.

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# ObservationTower

Observation tower: blue window drum + orange/white pinwheel roof cabin rising a lattice mast (OBS1).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# TwistRide

Twist: three arms with counter-rotating car clusters (TWIST1).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.

# Enterprise

Enterprise: pink-spoked pod wheel that spins up and lifts toward vertical (ENTERP).

Original three.js model on the shared Stage (day/night lighting); proportions and palette referenced from the RCT2 asset library.
